hooks.command: command -v vibe-guard >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "vibe-guard is not installed; install it: go install github.com/Manual-debuger/VibeConform/cmd/vibe-guard@v0.14.0-alpha.1, or download it from https://github.com/Manual-debuger/VibeConform/releases/tag/v0.14.0-alpha.1" >&2; exit 2; }; vibe-guard hook

vibe-guard relock 2>/dev/null; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && { task -x hook:stamp:check >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null || { task verify:fast 1>&2 </dev/null && task -x hook:stamp:save >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; } || task -x hook:done; }
